title: Should states keep the right to regulate AI?
plain: In July 2025 the Senate voted on Sen. Marsha Blackburn's amendment to strip a 10-year ban on state AI laws out of the big Republican tax-and-spending bill (H.R. 1). Yes meant states keep their power to regulate AI.
yea_means: Strip the ban: let states regulate AI
nay_means: Keep the ban on state AI laws
